robot: bam_fb_v2 (five-bar + UR wrist + crab claw v2.1), the sim2real build_rig('cad') bundle's body names
fitted: 2026-11-15 by PID tuna's reasoner: the 14b fit's five-bar transfer rows unchanged (11 real re-pick runs, 15304 moving J2 / C1 samples, docs/mass_refit's samples.npz) + 193 friction-cancelled W1 / W2 moving cells from 43 fullarm_stops runs (2026-11-14 01:24Z - 11-15 06:49Z, one power-up: the READY <-> READY-8 legs of the stops runs, run_042103's W1 READY..READY+15, run_044713's swung wrist, the hand-eye multi-stop sweeps W1 / W3 over +-140 deg at kp 75 and kp x4). No hold is a row.
method: one linear gravity model for both: theta = (m at the body origin, h = m c in the body frame) of l1, l2, c1, c2 and of the four wrist bodies (separately - no subtree scale), by weighted ridge least squares around the CAD (sigma 30 % of a body's mass, 20 mm x its mass per first moment). Five-bar rows: board torque - inertial (MuJoCo RNE, measured accelerations) = cos J1 x G + friction_j(v), friction odd in v (piecewise-linear in |v|), row sigma 1 N.m (docs/mass_refit's estimator verbatim). Wrist rows: per posture group (one gain class, the other joints within 5 / 10 deg) the + / - legs paired at matched angle and speed (docs/w1_offset/arithmetic.matched_half_sum); y = the half-sum of board torque - inertial, X = the per-body regressor half-summed over the same samples (so friction cancels and a posture mismatch inside a cell is in X as in y); sigma = the cell's standard error (+) a floor 0.01 N.m (0.02 for the +-140 deg sweeps: their cross-joint inconsistency). W3's cells are not rows (not gravity, below). The regressor is MeasuredWristFF's own posing (W1-W3) and MeasuredFivebarComp's (J2 / C1), equal to their MuJoCo RNE to 1e-14 N.m. Shoulder: the 14b file's (only J1 sees it; J1's holds are checks).
why: docs/w1_offset (twin_ring/w1_offset_2026-11-15.json): MeasuredWristFF over-fed W1 by ~0.08 N.m at READY <-> READY-8 because the 14b file's one wrist + claw subtree scale (x1.2208) came from W1 / W2 HOLDS, 13 of 15 resting from below on W1's static friction; its verifier showed W2's own moving half-sum is right at x1.22 (so the wrist is not one uniform scale) and that MeasuredFivebarComp runs on MeasuredWristFF's model (a naive x0.835 moves C1's READY FF +0.59 N.m). This file fits the wrist bodies on the wrist's own moving rows and the five-bar on its own, on ONE model, so the W1-W3 FF, the five-bar comp and the twin agree.

The wrist cells alone pin 6 wrist combinations (condition number 12.9 over them): (1) the subtree's horizontal first moment about W1 with the claw hanging (hard_stop_3's mass on its 74 mm lever with the bodies' x offsets) - W1 at READY; (2)-(3) the W2 subtree's two first-moment components across W2's axis - W2's legs and W1's gamma slope; (4)-(6) hard_stop's own and hard_stop_3's offsets across W1 as the +-140 deg sweeps rotate them. The five-bar rows pin 4 five-bar combinations (as in 14b: L2's mass at the elbow, L2's first moment toward W1, L1's along L1 with C2's mass, L2's cross term) and see the wrist as its total mass at W1's axis (with L2 free, that trade is flat: not_identified) plus the first moment W1 also sees

Also each wrist body's own mass (only their sum's levers show), every COM component along its own joint axis (hard_stop's along W1, hard_stop_3's along W3: only J1 would see them), the finger's COM (posterior / prior >= 0.98), the shoulder, inertias (scaled with mass)
